zoe: Quick heads-up: noticed a pattern where resumed streams after router rollouts end up with fragment IDs that overlap older fragments and we get +4..+9 token bumps. attaching a tiny log snippet.
mike: paste logs?
zoe:
```
2026-05-12T03:22:10Z INFO router: session=s-42 route=eu-north -> fallback; reason=conn-reset
2026-05-12T03:22:11Z INFO stream: frag_idx=0 frag_len=28 truncated=true toolcall=tc-9
2026-05-12T03:22:11Z INFO billing: provisional_tokens=28 ledger_key=s-42#0
2026-05-12T03:22:12Z INFO stream: resume attempt=1 resume_id=r-7 frag_idx=0 frag_len=33 suffix_included=true
2026-05-12T03:22:12Z INFO billing: confirmed_tokens=33 ledger_key=s-42#0
```
zoe: in the example ledger_key is same (s-42#0) but counts differ; in other hits resume produced ledger_key s-42#5, which created a new record.
tara: suspected cause: router instance A produced canonical_frag_id X, router B (on fallback) rewrites fragment indexing starting at 0 again. ledger currently uses session+frag_start which is ambiguous across reindexing.
mike: hmm, similar to previous suffix/reconnect cases but different root cause: canonical id rewrite. do we surface canonical_frag_id anywhere?
zoe: no, we don't currently. short term idea: if resume_id present, include resume_id in ledger_key to make the entry unique and allow dedupe on resume_id+frag_idx.
ara? tara: quick mitigation: billing shim should look for resume_id on confirm path. If resume_id present and provisional exists with same session and resume_hint (or time-window), prefer reconciling instead of creating a new entry. low-risk.
infra-bot: Deploy started: router/rollout v2026-05-12T02:55 by mike
billing-bot: FYI: manual corrections supported via /billing-evidence; prefer to add reconciliations first.
mike: patch idea: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ledger/pull/999 adds resume_id to confirmed writes and a reconciliation pass in the shim. I'll link tests.
tara: telemetry needs: emit resume_origin (local|fallback), resume_id, canonical_frag_id, frag_reindex_flag, and ledger_action (provisional|confirmed|reconciled) on every stream lifecycle event. sample 5% of resumes for full traces.
o: console-bot: suggestion: add per-route "provisional delta" compact metric and a link to sampled traces for 1% of triggered reconciles.
zoe: timeline? this is causing small customer annoyance and noisy alerts.
mike: i'll aim to land the ledger shim change behind a feature flag in 24h; tests + canary 48h.
tara: i'll add the console metric and a non-paging alert if per-route delta > 0.05% over 10m.
zoe: thanks. follow ups: - mike: PR link + test logs - tara: dashboard tile - infra: add resume_id header propagation in router hops
mike: will do. also include a migration approach: keep old_key mapping for 7 days to avoid orphaning provisional records.
billing-bot: Reminder: if you see a customer spike, tag sessions with evidence and /billing-evidence to queue manual review.
zoe: sweet. will monitor for further hits and drop samples here. :thumbsup:
